$description: The design tokens of aidd's built-in pages: the prototype viewer, its design format doc, `aidd status --html`, and `aidd explore`. The Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10. This file is the one owner of every value: `aidd gen-docs` writes the CSS each page reads and DESIGN.md's token front matter from it, and `aidd gen-docs --check` fails on drift. Color roles take shadcn/ui's variable names, and the scale takes Tailwind v4's theme namespaces, so a later rebuild carries them over unchanged. Each theme holds the same role names; a role that equals another names it as an alias. Change it in its own change: `aidd risk --paths` routes it major, through the aidd_toolkit area.

contrast.$description: Every color pair a page draws, checked in both themes (WCAG 2.2): 4.5 for text (SC 1.4.3), 3 for a control's edge, a focus indicator, an icon, or a state fill (SC 1.4.11). [foreground role, background role, the least ratio, where a page draws it].

secondary text on a hovered or current row
secondary text in the active comment
the primary button, a pressed segment, a chosen row, the Blocked flag, the toast

the Done count in a board column
Passed or Done on a current row
a warning flag on a current row
the Emergency flag on a current row or card
the edge of a button or a field
the edge of a control in a panel
the focus ring in a panel
the focus ring on a hovered or current row
the focus ring beside a hairline
the focus ring on the artboard
a pressed segment's or chosen row's fill
a meter's fill on its track
the emergency banner's icon and edge
a comment pin on the artboard
a link on a card or in the dialog
a link on a hovered or current row
text on a card or in the dialog

a link inside the emergency banner

comfort.$description: The comfort bands above the WCAG floor, checked from the tokens in both themes, the one owner of their numbers. The bands are aidd's own convention, calibrated on Material 3's levels and measured with APCA as an aid, never APCA's own thresholds or its size table. Body text is foreground on background: at least wcag_min, and its APCA |Lc| inside the theme's band. Secondary text is muted-foreground on background: |Lc| at least secondary_apca_min, and at least emphasis_gap_min below body text. Each of fills is a large fill at |Lc| fill_apca_max or less on each of fill_surfaces. Disabled text, input, keeps |Lc| disabled_apca_min or more on each of them. Each of wide_fills keeps OKLCH chroma at wide_fill_chroma_max or less. The dark page sits at OKLCH L dark_page_oklch_l_min or more. APCA-W3 0.0.98G-4g is a candidate contrast method outside any W3C standard (emerging), so it marks a target, and WCAG 2.2 AA stays the floor.

light.$description: The light theme. shadcn/ui's roles first, then aidd's own.

background.$description: The page: an off-white, so a card and a dialog lift one step to white

card.$description: A card on a board column: white, one step above the off-white page, as a menu and the dialog are

popover.$description: A menu, the keys dialog, and the toast's page behind it: a floating layer, with the one shadow

primary.$description: The one primary action, a pressed segment, a chosen row, the Blocked flag, and the toast: a graphite fill one step off the text in light, a soft light grey in dark, so a large fill never glares

primary-foreground.$description: Text and icons on a primary fill

secondary.$description: Not drawn by a page today; kept for the shadcn/ui mapping

muted.$description: A panel, a callout, a board column, a words-to-copy field, a table's header

muted-foreground.$description: Secondary text: an id, a count, a time, a hint

accent.$description: A hovered control or row, and the current row a keyboard cursor points at

destructive.$description: An error; the pages offer no destructive action

border.$description: A hairline between rows and around panels, and a meter's track: the text at 12%, so it reads the same on every surface; decorative, so it needs no contrast

input.$description: The edge of a button, a field, a segment, and kbd

ring.$description: The focus ring: a blue of its own, so focus never reads as pressed, chosen, or a state

ring-halo.$description: The soft halo outside a focused field: the ring at 25%, which the CSS writes as a color-mix of the ring

link.$description: A link's text: where you can go. Never a fill, and never a state

backdrop.$description: The neutral artboard a design frame or a screenshot sits on, so neither a light nor a dark design is judged against a tint

shadow-color.$description: The ink of the one shadow, under a floating layer

pass.$description: A run that passed, and finished work. Never a state a person has only looked at

pending.$description: Waits: not run, not answered, not seen. Neutral, because waiting is the normal state; a dashed outline carries it

warn.$description: Look at this, though nothing stopped: a file aidd cannot read, an overdue flag, a link that opened something else

emergency.$description: An open emergency: a production repair. Always with its icon and the word Emergency

emergency-foreground.$description: Text on an emergency fill: the overdue banner

comment.$description: A person's or an agent's comment on a design: its pin, its count, and Add a comment. Only the viewer draws it

comment-subtle.$description: The active comment's background, and selected text in the viewer

diff-added.$description: An added line, with its + sign

diff-removed.$description: A removed line, with its - sign

dark.$description: The dark theme: the same role names, each checked on its own background.

card.$description: Raised one step above the page in dark mode

font.$description: Tailwind v4: font.family is --font-*, font.weight is --font-weight-*, font.size is --text-* with its --text-*--line-height.

sans.$description: Every word but code: the reader's own system font, so nothing loads

mono.$description: Ids, paths, commands, and the words to copy; never prose

semibold.$description: Headings, titles, the primary button, a flag

meta.$description: 12 px at the default size: ids, counts, kbd, code, a hint

body.$description: 14 px: body text, controls, rows; Tailwind's text-sm

title.$description: 16 px: an item's title, a section heading, a lead

spacing.$description: Tailwind v4's --spacing-*: each step is 0.25rem times its name, so spacing.3 is Tailwind's p-3. A _ stands for the decimal point, which a token name cannot hold: spacing.1_5 is p-1.5.

0_5.$description: Between the one-line cards of a board column

1_5.$description: Between an icon and its label, and between the controls of a group

size.$description: The sizes a component draws. Tailwind v4 reads each as a --spacing-* key: size.control is h-control.

control.$description: A button, a field, a segment group, and the select: 30 px tall at the default size

target.$description: The least a control or a link in a list draws, both ways (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8)

icon.$description: An icon, drawn with a 1.6 stroke

container.$description: Tailwind v4's --container-*: the widest a page's column runs.

text.$description: A page of rows and prose: Needs you, Search, the explore page's question

prose.$description: A block of prose a person reads, with the .prose class: about 80 characters a line at 14 px (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.8)

page.$description: A page with a side column: an item, the Tree, the explore page's directions

radius.$description: shadcn/ui's --radius is radius.lg; its sm and md are radius.lg less 4 and 2 px, as here.

sm.$description: kbd, a flag, a badge's corner

md.$description: A button, a field, a segment group, a words-to-copy field

lg.$description: A panel, a callout, a board column, a dialog

full.$description: A count badge and a comment pin

thick.$description: The current tab's underline, the current row's bar, the emergency banner's edge

focus.$description: The focus ring in color.ring (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.7 and 2.4.11). A button, a link, a tab, a segment, and the switch draw an outline offset from the control, with a halo in color.background that keeps it visible on a fill. A field, a select, and a textarea draw no outline: their own border turns to the ring and doubles inside, with a soft halo outside.

field-halo.$description: The soft halo outside a focused field, in color.ring-halo

shadow.$description: The one shadow, for a floating layer only: the keys dialog, a menu, the toast. Its color is the theme's shadow-color.

duration.$description: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, both are 0 ms.

standard.$description: Every movement: fast out, gentle in

breakpoint.$description: Tailwind v4's default --breakpoint-*: a media query names one of these, in rem, by range syntax: (width < 40rem).

sm.$description: Below it, a phone: the tabs take their own row

md.$description: Below it, the viewer's panels become a tab bar

lg.$description: Below it, side columns move under the main one

xl.$description: From it, the viewer shows both side panels
